last_findings: 2026-11-11: main CI green on 60753ef. Nightly formal (quint job) hit its 240 min timeout; merged PR 95 raising it to 350. PRs 90-94 skipped: touched within 24h. Dependabot, audit, Commonware not checked (Monday only).
lessons: The state branch did not exist on first run; create it from main.
Force-push to a PR branch is denied in this environment; use update_pull_request_branch, or open a replacement PR from a new branch.
commonwarexyz/monorepo is not readable through the GitHub tools; fetch its releases page with WebFetch instead.
Replacing a conflicted PR: rebase locally, push a new branch, open a new PR, comment and close the old one. Do not cite PR numbers in the new PR body (AGENTS.md).
get_job_logs needs return_content=true and tail_lines; the mutation job log tail shows only cleanup, so read the uploaded mutants report artifact instead.
Nightly formal run time grew 63 min to over 4 h; a cancelled run at exactly the timeout means a timeout, not a user cancel.
